service.not-found: No wvkbd binary found. Install wvkbd or set one in the plugin settings.

binary.description: Path or command name. Empty looks for a custom build first, then wvkbd-mobintl and wvkbd-deskintl, on PATH and in ~/applications/wvkbd.
binary.label: wvkbd binary

colors.description: Take the background, keys and text from the Noctalia palette, or keep the colours compiled into the binary.
colors.label: Colours

font.description: Pango font for the key labels, such as "Sans 14". Empty keeps the compiled-in font.
font.label: Font

height.description: Height of the docked keyboard in pixels. 0 uses 30% of the output height.
height.label: Height

layers.description: Comma-separated layouts to cycle through, such as "full,special". Empty keeps the compiled-in layers.
layers.label: Layers

lifetime.description: Stop the keyboard when it is hidden, or keep the process and show it again instantly.
lifetime.label: When hidden

rounding.description: Corner radius of the keys in pixels. -1 keeps the compiled-in radius.
rounding.label: Key rounding
